ValidationRule.description: This validation rule prevents the user to select contact associated with Customer account for dealer case and select contact associated with Dealer account for All cases case
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR( ISPICKVAL( Country__c , 'United Kingdom'), ISPICKVAL( Country__c , 'Ireland')), OR(AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'VFS_Dealer', Contact.Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Account'), AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'All_Case', Contact.Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Dealer_Account')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select Contact associated with Dealer account for dealer case and contact associated with customer account for All cases case
